- Present: the word "Rechnung" at top (German for Invoice), labels "Nummer", "Datum", line items, totals ("Gesamtbetrag", "Netto", "Brutto", "Zahlbetrag"), VAT mentions ("USt", "20.00%"), monetary totals with EUR — strong invoice indicators.
- Exclusion terms such as "Zahlungserinnerung"/"Mahnung" do not appear prominently. Document is an invoice. Proceed to extraction.

2) Locate clearly labeled fields
- Invoice number: Label "Nummer 6524000050" — clear.
- Invoice date: Label "Datum 26.01.2024" — clear; date format DD.MM.YYYY.
- Sender VAT ID: Search for "Ust-Id-Nr." / "Ust.-ID-Nr." — two occurrences:
  - Near header: "Ihre Ust-Id-Nr. ATU64131246" — likely customer's VAT ID field? It is under right-side header "Ihre Ust-Id-Nr." which means "Your VAT ID". That refers to recipient, not sender.
  - Footer: "Ust.-ID-Nr. ATU69710958" in company registration line (Creaton GmbH) — this is the sender's VAT ID. So Sender.VatId = "ATU69710958".
  - Confirm no other clearly labeled sender VAT. Choose ATU69710958.

- Look for "Zahlbetrag" (amount to pay) — shows "Zahlbetrag 47,16 EUR". That is final amount after skonto? The line reads:
  - "Gesamtbetrag Brutto 48,52 EUR"

- The Zahlbetrag of 47,16 EUR is likely the payable amount shown. Decimal separator is comma; must convert to number with same decimal digits. So GrandTotal.Amount = 47.16 (number).

4) VAT groups (Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount)
- There is a VAT group line: "R2 - 20,00% USt auf 40,43 ... 8,09 EUR"

- Therefore one VAT item: Vat.Rate = 20 (rule: remove % symbol), Net.Amount = 40.43 (preserve decimals), Vat.Amount = 8.09.

- Schema has top-level "Net.Amount": "Net amount (excluding VAT)". The invoice net total is "Gesamtbetrag Netto 40,43 EUR" so Net.Amount = 40.43.

8) Sender.VatId confirmed as ATU69710958 (from footer Ust.-ID-Nr.)

9) Invoice.Date as string: "26.01.2024" (preserve format).

10) GrandTotal.Amount numeric keep decimals: 47.16.

11) Verify absence of other VAT groups or exchange rates
- No other VAT rates appear. Only R2 20.00%. No exchange rates for whole invoice.

12) Ensure no inference beyond visible text
- Do not guess currency or reassign VAT from "Ihre Ust-Id-Nr." — used footer Ust.-ID-Nr. for sender.
